Intro_Start.text: {fadeOutBg:100}{center}{color:lime}{blip:3}November 21st 7:51 PM{nl}Joyapolis Colosseum{p:6000}{hideTextbox}{playVideo:intro}{skip:0}{sectionEnd}
{setSkipEnabled:true}{fadeBg:JoyPolis}{center}{color:lime}{blip:3}{showTextbox}November 21st 8:32 PM{nl}Joyapolis{color:white}{p:1500}

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(My name is Phoenix Wright.)

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(I'm a defense attorney at Wright Anything Agency.)

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(I was hired by Mareka, the suspect in a murder case...)

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(And I've come to Joyapolis.)

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(To prove Mareka's innocence, I cannot overlook even the smallest detail!)

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(I should write down all the {color:red}【information】{color:lightblue} I find{nl}in the {color:red}【Court Record】{color:lightblue}.)

Intro_Start.name: Edgeworth
Intro_Start.text: {startBGM:investigation}{hideTextbox}{sprite:Edgeworth["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{color:white}{blip:1}Detective Gumshoe, please.{nl}Give me an overview of the case.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {fadeOutBg:500}{color:lightblue}{blip:0,false}(That's Miles Edgeworth.{nl}A prosecutor at the District Prosecutor's Office.)

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {fadeInBg:500}{hideTextbox}{fadeOutCharacter:300}{sprite:Gumshoe["Sad"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Yes sir!

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {fadeOutBg:500}{color:lightblue}{blip:0,false}(That's Detective Gumshoe.{nl}A detective with the Metropolitan Police.)

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {fadeInBg:500}{sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}{blip:1}{showEvidenceIcon:left,Yumi}The victim was the renowned actress{nl}Yumi.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {hideEvidenceIcon}She was scheduled to star in the special event{nl}"21st Century Champion" at Joyapolis.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:1,false}{flash}{playSound:question1}21st Century Champion?

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {hideTextbox}{fadeOutCharacter}{fadeOutBg:500}{p:500}{bg:Don_Cage}{fadeInBg:500}{showTextbox}"21st Century Champion" is a theatrical performance{nl}themed around futuristic fighting held in a cage.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {showEvidenceIcon:left,Desi}A murder occurred during rehearsal.{nl}The suspect is co-star Mareka.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {hideEvidenceIcon}The murder took place inside the cage,{nl}the stage for "21st Century Champion".

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {fadeBg:Yumi_back}The victim was struck on the back of the head with an urn{nl}and never moved again.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: The cause of death was blunt force trauma to the brain.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: No fingerprints were found, but we believe the murder weapon{nl}is the broken urn found nearby.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: The estimated time of death is between 7:20 PM and 8:12 PM,{nl}when the ambulance arrived.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: The paramedics confirmed her death.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}The first person to discover the body was a talent agency president...

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {showEvidenceIcon:left,Don}Don.{nl}He was also the executive producer of this show.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:1,false}{color:white}Don...{flash}{playSound:question1}The Don?{nl}The legendary kingpin of show business?

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: {hideEvidenceIcon}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}That's right.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: He claims he witnessed the suspect strike the victim's head with the urn.

Intro_Start.name: Gumshoe
Intro_Start.text: Due to the stage's structure, only the suspect could have entered{nl}the murder scene, so she was arrested.

Intro_Start.name: Edgeworth
Intro_Start.text: {hideTextbox}{hideCharacter}{bg:JoyPolis}{sprite:Edgeworth["Normal"]}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{blip:1}And that's the situation.

Intro_Start.name: Edgeworth
Intro_Start.text: {sprite:Edgeworth["Angry"]}Wright.{nl}This trial will be difficult for you.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:1,false}{color:white}No way. Mareka{nl}would never commit murder.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: No matter how tough it gets, I will absolutely{nl}prove her innocence!

Intro_Start.name: Edgeworth
Intro_Start.text: {sprite:Edgeworth["Normal"]}{blip:1}Then I'll see you in court.

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright, let me start my investigation right away.)
{setState:intro_done,true}{jump:Intro_Done}{sectionEnd}
